generation.scope: Every finite window with four regular central quartic parameters has prime folding and normal Gorenstein rational center, without additional hypotheses. Exactly the normalization degree/vertex index pairs (4,4) and (16,2) are possible as a dichotomy. The first has an ordinary quartic or quartic double-quadric center; the second has a smooth genus-nine generic K3 section.
